book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.spectr:
Spectral Ascension carries Spectrum's equipment into the late game of the Allthemodium metals: four new tiers, from Trichromatic to Prismatic.\
\
Perhaps there is a metal out there stronger than bedrock itself, waiting for someone worthy of it.\
\
This is an **unofficial addon**, made and maintained by its own authors, not by the Spectrum team. Please report its issues to the addon, not to Spectrum.\
\
Thanks to DaFuqs and the Spectrum team for the permission and for Spectrum itself.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t6_equ: Trichromatic Equipment

Bedrock was only the beginning. Deep in the ancient cities I found a golden metal, Allthemodium, and in a **Fusion Shrine** filled with **Dragonrot** it drank in the three pigments as if it had been waiting for them.\
\
I joined the **unbreakability of Bedrock** with the **magical properties of Allthemodium**: what was born of it knows no wear, and no enchantment needs to guard it any longer.\
\
*Three colors, one metal.*
The Full Set

The Dike trinkets I fused into the armor did not vanish: wearing all four pieces surrounds me with an **Azure Dike** as strong as all of them together, and it recharges just as quickly.\
\
But once the full set is on, the Azure Dike trinkets in my trinket slots stop working: their power already lives in the armor.
item.spectral_ascension.armor.tooltip.se: Full set: grants %s units of Azure Dike
item.spectral_ascension.armor.tooltip.tr: While the full set is worn, Azure Dike trinkets in trinket slots are disabled
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t6_equ: My Glass Crest Workstaff went into the fusion and came out as the pickaxe of this metal, without losing anything I had given it. Every vein I open gives me more than before.
My Bedrock Axe, reborn. Trees and foes alike go down before I have finished the swing.
I barely push it into the ground and whole mountains of earth are already gone. I should be careful where I point it.
Every harvest I gather with it is richer than the last. I have started planting more just to see how far it goes.
No whetstone could ever give it this edge, and it will never need one: it does not dull.
It keeps the steady aim and the long sight of the Bedrock Bow, but now its arrows strike with a force that surprises even me.
Like the Bedrock one it fishes even in lava, and the sea has become far more generous with me.
Wool, leaves, cobwebs: they cut through everything as if it were not there.
I set a Puff Circlet into the Bedrock Helmet. Together with the rest of the armor, the trinkets inside seem to work again.

An Azure Dike Ring went into this one. It shields me from every kind of harm, and the bedrock cape still falls from its shoulders. Together with the rest of the armor, the trinkets inside seem to work again.

With an Azure Dike Belt inside, explosions have lost almost all their bite against me.\
Together with the rest of the armor, the trinkets inside seem to work again.

A Shieldgrasp Amulet and an Azuresque Dike Core went into these. Fire and lava hardly frighten me anymore.\
Together with the rest of the armor, the trinkets inside seem to work again.
The Glass Crest Ultra Greatsword kept its enchantments and gained reach: it strikes farther, and when I slam it into the ground it throws back everything around me harder than before.
The Glass Crest Crossbow came out of the fusion more willing in my hands: it loads faster, and its bolts fly faster and straighter.
I fused a Ferocious and a Fractal Bident into one, and now I am the one who chooses the power I need in the moment.
item.spectral_ascension.bident.switch_hi: Sneak + Use to open the mode menu
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t6_hin: Bedrock is the toughest thing I have ever worked with, yet something nags at me: it feels like a beginning, not an end. Somewhere down in the ancient cities, a golden metal glimmers with more than mere strength.

That golden metal will not be worked on just any bench: it needs an altar worthy of it, and I have a feeling my best equipment has not had its last word yet.\
\
*Anything less would only embarrass it.*
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t7_equ: Now even stone seems to give way to it out of fear, and whatever it tears from the rock comes out still warm.
Heavier and longer than the last one: it strikes farther, and when I slam it into the ground it hits harder still.
It loads faster than ever, and its bolts fly faster and truer. I barely have to aim anymore.
It kept everything it was, and now its strikes slip deeper through armor and protection.
It falls like a shadow, and the tree is down before I hear it.
The earth opens before it as if it remembered the dark below.
The soil it turns gives back more than I ever gave it.
Its edge is so dark it seems to cut the light itself. I try not to stare at it.
Its arrows leave the string like shadows, and hit harder than any before them.
Water and lava give up their treasures to it, a little more willingly each time.
They close without a sound, and the cut is already made.
Arrows and projectiles slide off it like rain off onyx.
Heavier than it looks, sturdier than before, and the cape still flows from its shoulders.
The blast of an explosion barely reaches me now.
Fire and lava frighten me even less than before.

I thought the three pigments had nothing left to teach me. Then, in the Nether, I found a green metal, Vibranium, and when I held it up to the light it *drank* it, the way Onyx does: a metal that keeps a little of the dark inside.\
\
*Whatever it had learned, it kept.*

book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t8_equ: Stone parts before it like mist in moonlight, and what it digs never even touches the ground: I find it already in my pack.
Its reach grows longer still, and when I slam it into the ground it hits harder than ever.
It loads faster still, and now its bolts leave so fast they seem to arrive before the sound.
It forgot nothing of what it was, and its strikes pierce armor and protection deeper than before.
A pale flash, and the tree is already down.
The earth opens before it as if the moon had asked.
Whatever grows where it passes seems to reach toward the light.
Its edge gleams like moonlight on still water, and cuts just as cleanly.
Its arrows fly like shards of moonlight, and hit harder than ever.
Water and lava give up their treasures to it even more willingly, and the bites come sooner.
They close with a glint, and the cut is already made.
Arrows and projectiles glance off it like light off Moonstone.
Lighter than it looks and tougher than before; the cape still flows from its shoulders.
An explosion right beside me now sounds like distant thunder.
I walk through fire as if it were moonlight.

The dark kept everything I gave it, but gave nothing back. Then, in the End, I found a violet metal, Unobtainium, and it does the opposite: hold it under the moon and it *returns* the light, pale and whole, the way Moonstone does.\
\
*The shadow is still in there. Now it shines.*

gui.spectral_ascension.bident_menu.feroc: Riptide even out of water, hurting whatever you touch (White Ink)
gui.spectral_ascension.bident_menu.fract: Throws a Mirror Image and stays in your hand (White Ink)
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t9_equ: This version I discovered seems to need no White Ink at all: the alloys carry the light themselves.
My experiments led me to this longer, heavier version that is remarkably powerful.
These experiments help me a great deal: this new crossbow loads in a heartbeat and its bolts fly so close to the target that it takes real effort to miss.
This improvement furthers its ability to slip past the enemy's armor and protection. Very little can stop it now.
This new axe fells trees in an instant; I marvel at its speed.
This improvement brought such speed that I seem to see rainbows when I use it. Maybe I should get myself checked…
Since I started using this hoe, it seems that whatever I plant takes on every color.
This sword is far too light to be called one, yet it seems to have a devastating effect and shows no sign of breaking despite how thin it is.
The arrows I shoot from this bow strike with a force and precision I did not think possible, and now they seem to leave a trail of shining colors behind them.
The new colors of the hook seem to call everything that lives, and doesn't, in water and lava.
They close in a shimmer, and the cut is already made.
Arrows and projectiles scatter off it like light through a prism.
Lighter than it looks and tougher than ever; these materials work wonders.
My leggings now keep me from even realizing the danger of an explosion.
Fire and lava? You mean rain and water — this improvement makes me ignore them as if they were nothing.
Prismatic Equipment

Three metals, and I kept them apart as if they were rivals. Melted two by two they stop fighting: now the light that hits them splits into *every* color at once.\
\
*Every color, all of them in one place.*
The Full Set

Wearing all four pieces seems to keep the **Azure Dike** properties I used in the original creation.\
\
However, once the full set is on, the Dike trinkets seem to stop working.

book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.bedroc:
My mace hits hard when I drop on something from high above, but every blow wears it down a little. So I tried what had already worked for my other tools, and the bedrock took to it without complaint.\
\
*Heavier than the sky, and it will never break.*
Now every blow from above ends in a gust of wind that throws me back up toward the sky.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t6_equ: My Bedrock Mace drank in the three pigments too. It falls heavier than before, and the wind it raises lifts me higher.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t7_equ: It falls from the sky like a shadow, and the gust that follows carries me even higher.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t8_equ: A pale flash from above, and the wind throws me back up toward the moon.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.t9_equ: These alloys make it light in my hand and terribly heavy when it lands. The wind it raises now throws me higher than I would ever dare to jump.
book.spectral_ascension.guidebook.spectr:
Gold in the ancient cities, green in the Nether, violet in the End. I carried each one home and watched my Spectrum gear take them in as if it had been waiting all along.\
\
The last one was different. It did not shine. It *listened*.\
\
*Some doors only open from the far side of the bedrock.*
*Pro tip: the built-in resource pack "Eternal Classics" gives the equipment a different style. Switch it on in the resource packs menu.*
